decision: Owner, 2026-10-30: retain sequence as a frozen research challenger, keep summary as the default research baseline, and run one preregistered prospective shadow trial with a shuffled control.

arms.summary: PR #19 frozen summary model (models.json), temperature from summary.json
arms.sequence: PR #19 frozen sequence model (models.json), temperature from summary.json
arms.shuffled: control_model.json: the sequence recipe fitted on 2020-2021 with each row's 20-day window shuffled separately (one permutation per row, the day's return, range and volume kept together; premove_shadow.shuffle_windows); temperature chosen on 2022 by log loss

same_for_every_arm.universe: the crypto routine's Binance USDT pull (trading pairs), non-stable, non-leveraged (global_panel.STABLE / LEVERAGED, the benchmark's own exclusion)
same_for_every_arm.eligibility: premove_core.build_examples unchanged: 60 consecutive valid days, median prior 20-day quote volume >= 100,000 USDT, finite features; only completed bars
same_for_every_arm.target: PR #19 unchanged: entry = next UTC day's open (label reference only), barrier b = max(log 1.10, 3 x 20-day sd x sqrt 5), first daily close beyond +/-b within 5 days
same_for_every_arm.budget: five names per arm per day, highest upside probability, ties by ticker

timing: each day's forecast is sealed after that UTC day closes (crypto routine, about 00:25 UTC) and before its outcome bars exist; the label's entry reference is that 00:00 UTC open, which no feature reads. The ledger is hash-chained and externally timestamped.

trial.stopping: fixed: no early stop, no extension, no performance-based change

analysis.primary: early-population daily hit rate, sequence minus summary (censored alerts count as non-hits)
analysis.uncertainty: paired moving calendar-block bootstrap of daily hit-rate differences, 95% interval
reported_beside: probability quality (Brier, log loss) of every candidate

promotion_hurdle.rule: sequence becomes the default research baseline only if, at the end, its early hit rate beats summary's by at least 1 percentage point, the paired 95% interval is above zero, and it catches more distinct episodes; otherwise summary stays the default
promotion_hurdle.temporal_order: attributing the gain to the ORDER of days additionally needs sequence to beat the shuffled control with a paired 95% interval above zero
promotion_hurdle.note: a research hurdle, not economic breakeven; neither arm has shown trading profit

honesty: 12 months may be inconclusive: the retrospective +0.88 point difference had a 95% interval of -0.22 to +1.81; detecting a stable advantage of that size could take about 2.5 to 3 years. An inconclusive end leaves summary as the default; the trial is not extended until it becomes significant.
the live universe is today's trading pairs, not the archive catalogue the models were fitted on

the control was fitted on a re-collected vintage (2026-10-30T21:31:39.617319Z) whose panel is byte-identical to PR #19's input: True; its refit of the frozen arms on that vintage is recorded in control_model.json

the live USDT universe now includes tokenized US-stock pairs (for example AAPLB, SPYB) that did not exist in the 2020-2023 training catalogue; the benchmark's universe rule includes them and is kept unchanged for every arm (seen in the pre-freeze dry run of 2026-10-29, before any outcome)
paper only: no orders, no execution or profit claim
